name: shell-coverage
//: llmlint: ignore-file[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] JSON has no comment to scope this to `coverage`, which is what it is about: the shell line floor is ONE report over every project's shell test steps, so it depends on every `test` that runs scripts/shell-test.sh, the binary e2e journeys included, by design — leaving any out would let those scripts' coverage slip outside the floor (scripts/check-nx-graph.mjs refuses exactly that). Each `test` is still selected by the graph and replays its kcov report from the cache when its inputs are unchanged. Selected through its inputs whenever a shell script changes, never through project-graph edges: its `dependsOn` orders tasks and adds no project dependency. How the floor is measured and why it skips macOS and Windows: tools/shell-coverage/AGENTS.md.
